user_source_statement: 欧洲空间局 ESA 的 Copernicus DEM GLO30-CHINA
product_surface_type: DSM; includes buildings, infrastructure and vegetation
source_assessment: Product identified by user, specifications checked against official source. The local mosaic release, original tiles and processing/vertical-conversion history are not independently reconstructed.
execution_condition: Treat the mosaic as retaining original metre EGM2008 heights, explicitly conditional on user-declared product lineage; do not call it verified bare-earth terrain or reference truth.
height_conversion: Requires a hashed local EGM2008 geoid grid; h=H+N. Never replace N by zero or use EGM96.
receiver_height_condition: M1 receiver height remains explicit ellipsoid height. Height above DSM is not necessarily AGL above bare earth.
